It's by Truman Dickerson, dated Wed, 11 November 2026, and headlined "Dario Amodei says AI will cure cancer and Alzheimer's in a decade. Doctors aren't buying it." It says that in "a 42-minute IPO roadshow video the company released on Tuesday", Amodei said "cancer, Alzheimer's, heart disease, mental illness — these will be relics of the past in, I think, less than a decade." That matches the candidate word for word. "Tuesday" before an article dated Wednesday 11 November means 10 November 2026. This is a news report, not the video or a transcript. But the wording differs: four named diseases becoming "relics of the past", against "most major diseases". Someone needs to compare it with the recorded file.
